caption: Gran Cratere, Vulcano
composition: Sulfur-stained crater rim with fumarole steam above the Aeolian Sea · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the crater rim the sulfur-stained slopes fall away in ochre, grey and pale yellow, thin wisps of fumarole steam rising at the right. The Aeolian Sea spreads left and center, hazy island silhouettes on the horizon. Scattered clouds drift across the bright 08:42 morning sky above the steaming crater.
